{{Quote|Be welcome. Your pilgrimage was expected. But surprising.|Kina-Re|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Kina-Re''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Voss Mystics|Mystic]] living [[Voss]] on during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. Working at the [[Shrine of Healing]], she was looking over [[Kindra Gann]], an outsider suffering from a rare form of [[Mizra Syndrome]]. However, when news arrived that Kindra's mother was on her deathbed, she allowed her to leave, saying that the family was sacred for the [[Voss]].
